notes: Ethereum mainnet, chainId 1. Constructor(IPoolManager poolManager, address token), resolved by the launch factory. Deploy SIMDTESTHook directly with CREATE2; address & 0x3fff must equal 0x20c4. Static LP fee 12500 (1.25%) plus a 100 bps hook fee on actual unspecified-currency fill, collected as hook-owned ERC-6909 claims. No LP override. Anyone may sweep token claims to the dead address or execute a buyback each 3600 seconds using at most 25% of IMD holdings. The 300 bps pool-price limit uses the tighter of epoch TWAP and liquid spot bounds; in empty liquidity, retain the last liquid observation or initialization tick. Zero-spend attempts preserve the hourly slot and TWAP history. Initial price is provenance only; the factory atomically deploys and initializes, sets launch economics and distributes the full 1e27-unit supply. No owner or post-launch settings.
